implementation_principle.name: FULL ARCHITECTURE NOW -> REAL CONNECTORS WHEN AVAILABLE -> NO REDESIGN REQUIRED
requirements: Build the complete production-target architecture, interfaces, schemas, workflows, UI states and integration boundaries now.

Do not remove, disable, downgrade or omit intended capability merely because an external API, credential, partner feed, authority connection, laboratory interface, sensor stream, production dataset, bank/Takaful integration or transaction is not yet available in the development environment.
Where an external dependency is unavailable, implement a replaceable adapter/sandbox/mock preserving the exact production integration boundary and complete user journey.
Development mocks may substitute data/connectivity only; they must never reduce the target functionality or become a permanent architectural limitation.

Do not impose arbitrary feature caps on manufacturer onboarding, evidence ingestion, smart-glass auditing, laboratory integration, traceability, digital twins, immutable evidence, JAKIM connectivity, logistics monitoring, port/customs access, GCC workflows, command-center analytics, AI/ML, predictive/preemptive strategies, finance/Takaful/tokenomics, multilingual capability, portals, APIs or future scale.

Do not fabricate live authority approvals, lab results, credentials, partner events, customs releases, financing approvals, Takaful underwriting decisions or production telemetry. Preserve complete target functionality while keeping source/transaction truth explicit.
